summary: Remote-driven agent runner executes Claude/Codex CLIs on the installer's host
details: @factiii/runner is a daemon that connects outbound to https://api.factiii.com and accepts commands over a WebRTC channel from paired Factiii web/mobile clients, dispatching them to local Claude/Codex agent CLIs. Receiving instructions from a network peer and executing them locally is a remote-shell dataflow with full-host blast radius: an authenticated remote operator can run arbitrary agent commands and whatever those agents are configured to do (shell, file edits, repo operations) on the installer's machine. The capability is documented in the package README ("run Board AI agents on a machine you control. Pairs with the Factiii web/mobile clients over WebRTC"), the channel is authenticated by browser pairing plus a JWT and optional connection password with credentials encrypted in the OS keychain, the connection is outbound-only (no public listener on the installer's host), and the daemon starts only when the operator explicitly runs the foreground `factiii-runner start` subcommand — no npm lifecycle hooks and no import-time side effects. No installer secrets outside the pairing credentials are read, no fetched code is executed, and no second undisclosed channel is present. The static POST hits in dist/cli.js correspond to the documented control-plane traffic to api.factiii.com, not to a hidden exfiltration endpoint.
